issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

maxPersistedDiagramViews.description: The maximum number of {@link EntityRelationshipDiagramView} in the ERD for the current app.

defaultDiagramViewId.description: The id for the default {@link EntityRelationshipDiagramView} to render on page load

showTestTypes.description:
If enabled, types that reside in the `test/` path will be included in the ERD
This is disabled by default.
